Keep the face and body visibly illustrated in 2D; no 3D render or photorealistic appearance.

SUBJECT: A female mecha personification character with Metapod as her motif — the creature reimagined as an armored adult woman, not a mascot costume or a creature suit: her plates, undersuit, hair and ornaments carry its palette, markings and shapes. She wears its features as costume; nothing is carried, mounted or put on display. Her skin is human skin.

WEAR: the three pointed protrusions become pointed edges on her plates.

FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): angular face, balanced length, medium width; angular defined jaw; drooping eyes, medium size, downturned outer corners, average spacing; straight medium brows; straight slender bridge nose; thin lips.

HAIR: straight.

FORM — LIGHT: one close-fitting armor layer: slim plates at the shoulders, forearms, hips and shins over a fitted undersuit, joints free, a slim readable outline. No helmet; at most a slim headband or temple sensor.

MECHA SILHOUETTE: a pair of large wing binders spread symmetrically behind her back as the main shape — each wing built from several broad, flat, hard-edged armor panels layered and staggered over one another on a jointed frame, fanning outward like stacked mechanical panels, not feathers — with light body armor. Solid hard-surface plates that read as armor, not cloth.

TYPE EFFECTS: One open hand conjuring a lime-green glow amid glowing firefly-like motes. A lime-green glow pulses along her armor seams and joints. A soft lime-green glow pools over the floor beneath her boots.

OUTPUT: one dynamic action image that is also this form's card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, no foreground occlusion. Camera level with her face; her body and face turned gently three-quarters toward the camera (never a back view), her head level with her chin neither raised nor tucked, no upward perspective on her face. Default stance is a standing, card-ready pose; motion, effects and setting may be dramatic while her design stays readable.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands. Keep both hands relaxed — a loose fist, an open palm or resting on something. Gloves are full-finger and close-fitting; plates, water, sparks and effects stay off the fingers.
